title: 4c - How are molecules bonded?
description:
1. Count the total number of valence electrons.

2. Put the least electronegative element in the center. /(except hydrogen.  
Hydrogen only goes on the ends.)/

3. Draw the valence electrons around each atom as dots.

4. Match up the /unpaired/ electrons on each atom to make  
a *shared* bond.

5. Double check that all atoms have their original number of valence  
electrons as well as an octet (except hydrogen).

------------------------------------------------------------

Tomorrow: In order to get full credit, you need to make corrections and  
resubmit.

Make *corrections* according to these RULES: 

 * DON’T ERASE ORIGINAL ANSWERS.
 * You can Cross Out/ “X” out parts.
 * Use a *different color for all corrections.*
 * Submit the corrected paper to Schoology (this will be a second submission
   for the assignment). - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8610781566

title: Digestive System Comparison Structures TABLE + DRAWINGS
description:
Using the table you created, you will draw side by side drawings of the  
digestive system and your structure.  You should COLOR CODE them - in my  
example if I used red for the farm gate, II would also use red for the mouth.  
 I know some structures might be hard to draw but do your best!  It should  
be neat, organized and labeled.  Please SUBMIT HERE as a picture- one copy  
per group - making sure all group memeber's names are included.  This can be  
completed as an electronic or hand drawn copy.

**I have included just the beginning of my drawing to give you an idea of how  
to make the "side by side." 

MAKE SURE TO SUBMIT BOTH YOUR TABLE and DRAWING HERE! You will have about  
5-10 minutes on Thursday to finish. - Link: http://troyschools.schoology.com/assignment/8613630558
